problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y={6}^{x}-0.75?$
worked_solution:
First, we plot the graph of $y={6}^{x}:$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13930907/assets/29d270676a48f4cf40625ef3ec50b0323c9c99389b2a7d080881727eda28de56.png)

To sketch the graph of $y={6}^{x}-0.75,$ we take the graph of $y={6}^{x}$ and shift it $0.75$ units down. The $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(0,0.25),$ and the horizontal asymptote moves from $y=0$ to $y=-0.75.$
